info.title: Delivery API
info.description: Cash delivery marketplace. Money uses integer cents. JSON rejects unknown fields. List endpoints use limit (1–100, default 20) and offset (0–100000). JWT identifies the actor; marketplace permissions and ownership are checked against current database state. Auth mutations share 20 requests per minute per IP per backend instance.
